profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Fidelity Investments
profile.summary: Passionate and quick learner with very high attention to detail. I pick things up fast and work best with a team. Easy to deal with and very adaptable to changes. I utilize my skills in order to help improve the well-being of the stakeholders in my company. Currently working as a Senior Software Engineer (Full-Stack) at Fidelity Investments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Jenkins, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Tech Stack: Java, Angular, Kubernetes, IBM Cloud, Docker, GitHub Actions, TypeScript, Cypress, Playwright, TDD, REST APIs

Lead development of scalable, cloud-native applications in a distributed systems environment using Java and Angular.

Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, improving deployment speed and reliability by 30%.

Automated end-to-end testing workflows using Cypress and Playwright, enhancing test coverage and reducing manual QA efforts.

Implemented and maintained IBM Cloud Kubernetes clusters, ensuring optimal system uptime and compliance with enterprise standards.

Advocated for and practiced Test-Driven Development (TDD), resulting in more robust and maintainable codebases.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated in agile teams using pair programming and code reviews to deliver quality features and reduce bugs early in development.

Played a key role in the integration of a multi-team kiosk payment application, coordinating service communication across systems.

Maintained and optimized Jenkins pipelines and later led the migration to GitHub Actions, streamlining CI/CD processes and increasing maintainability.

Contributed to containerization and orchestration strategies using Docker and Kubernetes within IBM Cloud.

positions.title: Software Developer - Contract via Brooksource
positions.description:
Developed and deployed backend services with Java and Spring Boot, integrating with Redis and REST APIs.

Wrote unit and integration tests using Mockito and Jest, supporting TDD practices for backend and frontend components.

Documented technical processes and application architecture to support knowledge transfer and onboarding efforts.

Supported cluster lifecycle management on IBM Cloud Kubernetes, applying security patches and performing system upgrades.
